question: What power to shake the triple world arises from contemplating a smoky color?
premises: One is to contemplate something smoke-colored continually.
The triple world is named as the object affected.
The verse states that it may be shaken.
inference: By continually contemplating a smoky color, one gains the power to shake the triple world.
plain_english: O beloved, by always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one can shake the triple world.
